zh_CN.speaker: narrator
zh_CN.text: 芹香坐在病床上，手边放着已经翻阅过几次的术前说明书。听见开门声，她抬起头，将纸页整齐地叠在一旁。

zh_CN.speaker: patient
zh_CN.text: 「术前说明。明明以前给患者解释过很多次，轮到自己躺在这里，却忍不住一遍遍地看。」

zh_CN.speaker: narrator
zh_CN.text: 她没有否认，只是把被子向上拉了拉。

zh_CN.speaker: patient
zh_CN.text: 「以前我总是在病床另一边。现在……连等你过来，都觉得有点不一样。」

en.speaker: narrator
en.text: Serika sits on the hospital bed, the preoperative information sheet she has read several times beside her. Hearing the door open, she looks up and neatly folds the pages to one side.

en.speaker: patient
en.text: “The preoperative information. I’ve explained it to patients so many times before, but now that I’m the one lying here, I can’t help reading it over and over.”

en.speaker: narrator
en.text: She does not deny it, only pulling the blanket a little higher.

en.speaker: patient
en.text: “I used to always be on the other side of the bed. Now... even waiting for you to come feels a little different.”

en.speaker: patient
en.text: “...Sit down. What would you like to talk about?”
